item.title: DoW Programs Fund Bachelors, Masters, and PhD Students: Virtual Info Session Scheduled for Sept. 23, 1pm
item.description: The DoW SMART Scholars and National Defense Science and Engineering Graduate programs fund up to five years for Bachelors, Masters, or PhD students in STEM fields. Citizens of the U.S., UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand are eligible to apply. Register HERE: https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE for the virtual information session on Sept 23rd at 1pm, or email madige@rpi.edu for more information.
item.author: Students

item.title: Give Back to the Community with RPI’s VITA Program
item.description: RPI is partnering with United Way of the Greater Capital Region to launch a new Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) site. Gain hands-on experience while helping members of the local community prepare their taxes. No previous tax experience is required, and training will be provided. Interested? Attend the information session on September 30 from 1–2 p.m. in the RPI Union’s Ellsworth Room (3602).

item.title: GE Vernova Resume Review Workshop at the CCPD!
item.description: Elevate your professional profile and stand out to top-tier employers! Join us for a hands-on Resume session! In this session, you’ll learn how to bridge the gap between your academic projects and industry expectations. Whether you are seeking your first internship or preparing for post-graduation roles, this workshop will provide you with the tools to craft a resume that truly reflects your potential. Location: CCPD, Darrin Communications Center Suite 209

item.title: Computer Science Colloquia - Pingkun Yan
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 4:00 AM - 5:00 AM - Medical images contain far more information than is typically used for a single diagnostic task. I will present our work on learning generalizable, patient-specific representations from routine chest imaging, tracing a progression from task-specific prediction to multimodal foundation models and spatially grounded world models. These results point toward medical AI systems that move beyond task specific prediction, with applications in risk…

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Workshop: “Coaching-Move People Forward”
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM - Leaders who are effective coaches create a relationship built on trust, meet the needs of those they are coaching and energize people to achieve a goal. In this seminar, participants will learn strategies for helping people move forward, grow their career and positively impact the organization. This is a two part seminar.
